title: SDK: download predefined sources (apricity-sources crate + CLI), starting with LoC Citizen DJ
description: New crate crates/apricity-sources: list_sources, status, fetch (idempotent, .part+rename, sha256, progress callback, injectable fetcher), remove. CLI: apricity sources list|status|fetch|remove. Catalog: loc-edison, loc-jukebox-classical, loc-jukebox-popular, loc-tony-schwartz (27 WAVs); Marine Band stays manual. Gherkin first (features/sources). Web UI out of scope. Second source will be the first drum kit.
